name: Victor Erico Migat
original_name: ヴィクトル・エリコ・ミガット
source:
One of the most brilliant and well-mannered students in the academy, and also the head of the dormitory. A hardworking person who is never satisfied with the status quo and is always striving for improvement. Extremely strict both with himself and others and has no mercy for those who are lazy. Calm, cool-headed and intelligent, he is never moved by emotion. Part of a family of wizards specialised in white magic who saved the country in the past, and his father is a member of parliament. He abhors black magic.

‘Please ask me for advice once you have actually made an effort. I hate people who don’t work hard, after all.’

[Translated from [url=http://www.daisy-daisy.in/products/majyu/]the official website[/url].]
